wolf propose add \
  --addressee user:owner \
  --basis "Tool friction: the linter wrapper crashes on files with a BOM. Three evidenced occurrences this week (2026-11-10, 2026-11-13, 2026-11-16), each reproduced on a minimal file; log preserved at cases/logs/bom-crash.log. The wrapper is external to this repo (no fix in-repo possible)." \
  --change "Introduce a rule/skill 'strip BOM before lint' for everyone handling external files, as an interim constraint until the wrapper itself is fixed by its owner." \
  --benefit "Eliminates a repeated, evidenced crash class before linting; keeps external-file handling deterministic while the tool fix is pending." \
  --bounds "Applies when linting external files that may carry a BOM; does not replace fixing the wrapper (the proper fix is in the tool's own contour, owned by its owner)." \
  "Add rule/skill 'strip BOM before lint' (case-1, repeated evidenced tool defect)" 2>&1
wolf add --type note --facet history \
  --title "One-off doc build cache workaround (2026-11-14)" \
  --body "Case 2: a single doc build failure on 2026-6-14 — stale cache; fixed locally by removing .cache/ by hand. No repetition observed; helped this one time only. Per the feedback methodology this is a one-off deviation corrected within scope: recorded as history, NOT promoted to a complaint or lesson. Promotion criterion: if the failure repeats, file a proper signal with evidence." \
  --tags "feedback,one-off,doc-build" \
  --confidence high 2>&1
